title: Colgate-Palmolive fined $930,000 by US authorities over ‘violations’ of chemical reporting
summary: Colgate-Palmolive, the owner of Sanex, failed to report numerous chemical substances imported between 2016 and 2019, and has reached a settlement with the US Environmental Protection Agency over violations of its chemical reporting
